In The Court Of Sh. Dinesh Kumar Sharma
 Principal District & Sessions Judge/
Food Safety Appellate Tribunal
New Delhi

Fsat No.05/2021
Kishan Lal & Ors. Vs Fso
Kishan Lal & Ors. .....Appellants
Versus
Food Safety Officer .....Respondent
 Date of filing :05.07.2021
 Date of arguments :23.11.2021

Date of Judgment :23.11.2021
Judgment

1. Vide this judgment, I shall dispose off the appeal challenging the impugned order dated 07.04.2021 passed by Ld. Adjudicating Officer/ADM (North) ("AO" in short) whereby the appellants have been held guilty for violation of Section 23(1) of The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Regulation No.2.2.1.3 r/w 2.3.1.5 of The Food Safety and Standards (Packaging and Labelling )
Regulations, 2011 and imposed penalty of Rs. Two Lacs upon the appellants in terms of Rule 3.1.2.1 of The Food Safety and Standards Rules, 2011.
2.

entities.text:
Food Safety and Standards (Packaging and Labelling )
Regulations, 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The appellants have challenged the impugned order on the ground that the allegation as to misbranding is totally baseless as this is the Govt. of India directive that "iodine helps mental development".
Therefore, there is no question of misleading the consumer in any manner.
3. Ld.
Chief PP for respondent has opposed the appeal on the ground that the AO has taken into account the relevant rules and has rightly imposed the penalty upon the appellants.
4. I have heard the submissions and perused the record.
5. Perusal of the impugned order indicates that the AO has not at all given any reason for arriving at the conclusion.
Reasons are the lifeline of any judicial order.
The AO has to bear in mind that he acts as quasijudicial officer while acting as AO in the proceedings under the FSS Rules.

During the course of submissions, Ld. Counsel for appellants have submitted that there is Food Safety and Standards (Advertising and Claims) Regulations, 2018 which is in favour of the appellants and had the AO taken that into consideration, the appellants could not have been held guilty.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards (Advertising and Claims) Regulations, 2018
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: I consider that in absence of any reasons by the AO, the impugned order dated 07.04.2021 cannot be sustained and is set aside.
The matter is remanded back to the AO for fresh hearing in accordance with law.
Parties are directed to appear before the AO on 07.12.2021.

The appellants may raise the plea of Food Safety Kishan Lal & Ors. vs Fso on 23 November, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82779296/
1 and Standards (Advertising and Claims) Regulations, 2018 before the AO.

entities.text: Food Safety Kishan Lal & Ors. vs Fso
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bank guarantee furnished by the appellants, be released to the appellants as per rules.
Appeal is disposed off accordingly.
6. TCR be sent back alongwith copy of the judgment.
7. File be consigned to Record Room.
